meta.note: Maps major Indian cities to the water board that serves them. hasTariffFile is true only where a real, schema-validated tariff JSON exists in src/data/water-tariffs/ — every other city still uses the honest self-rate-input calculator. Mirrors the discoms.json / gas-cgds.json pattern. IMPORTANT: unlike DISCOMs/CGDs, our /water/[slug] route is STATE-granularity (one page per state/UT), while water boards are CITY-granularity (a state can have multiple boards, e.g. Maharashtra has BMC for Mumbai, PMC for Pune, and PCMC for Pimpri-Chinchwad). Delhi, Chennai, Pimpri-Chinchwad, Hyderabad and Kolkata happen to work cleanly as city routes distinct from their state slugs (see src/app/water/[slug]/page.tsx, which checks board slugs independently of state slugs). BWSSB and BMC were researched but NOT added: their published rates conflict by large margins across every secondary source we could reach, and their official portals were unreachable (cert error / non-machine-readable legacy portal) — publishing either with a confident SOURCED label would risk a wrong number. Revisit if better sources turn up. BMC re-researched 2026-09-16 with the same result, but now with a clearer picture of WHY: three source lineages describe three structurally DIFFERENT billing mechanisms, not just different numbers — FreePressJournal (multiple dated articles through March 2026) says a flat ₹6/KL residential rate; an uncited aggregator says a volume-based KL slab structure (₹6/₹11/₹26); a dedicated 2021 Citizen Matters explainer (quoting BMC engineers) describes a per-capita-consumption (lpcd) based slab structure entirely, doubling/tripling per band. portal.mcgm.gov.in remains non-machine-readable. Guessing which mechanism is real would risk systematically wrong bills, not just an off-by-a-bit number — held back pending either a primary BMC notification or the user's own source. PMC (Pune, distinct from the already-live PCMC) was also researched 2026-09-16: pmc.gov.in's own Water Supply Department and Various Service Charges pages exist but return a technical fetch error; secondary sources give only a vague, uncited '₹5-15/KL, tiered' claim with no real slab breakdown. One tempting figure (MWRRA's ₹0.55/KL 'Bulk Water Tariff Order 2022') was checked and rejected — that's the wholesale rate the state charges PMC for raw water, not what PMC bills households. Held back pending a primary source. KMC (Kolkata) is a genuinely different case from every other board here: ordinary single-family Kolkata houses have no separate per-KL/slab water bill at all (likely bundled into property tax) — the only real recurring volumetric rate found in KMC's own official FY2026-27 fee schedule is a flat ₹6/KL BULK rate for housing complexes/gated communities. Modeled with tariff.isBulkOnly=true, which makes WaterBoardPage.tsx render a prominent top-of-page scope notice (housing complexes only, not individual houses) rather than silently presenting bulk figures as a per-house bill. Boards below other than DJB, CMWSSB, PCMC, HMWSSB and KMC are listed for future reference only. matchingDiscomCode (see water-boards.ts) drives the board-specific water<->electricity cross-links and is only set where the CITY-level match is confirmed, not assumed from `state` — deliberately left unset on kolkata, since WBSEDCL does NOT serve Kolkata itself (CESC does, and CESC has no calculator on this site); linking KMC to WBSEDCL would misrepresent which DISCOM actually powers Kolkata.
